audio.text: Didn't you say the study group was meeting in the library today?

options: It was, but they moved it to the student center.
Yes, the library closes at nine tonight.
I'd rather not join a new group this term.
No, I haven't been to the library yet.

why.en: A natural reply saying the plan has changed. B repeats "library" but does not answer.
why.tr: Planın değiştiğini söyleyen doğal yanıt. B "library" kelimesini tekrar edip soruyu yanıtlamıyor.
